name: Emrakul
aliases: the beast that lives within the moon
description: Emrakul is the third of the Eldrazi titans, an enormous eldritch creature that was bound in the moon of Innistrad.

"The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

summary.text: Emrakul is the third of the Eldrazi titans, an enormous eldritch creature that was bound in the moon of Innistrad.

bio.text: The Gatewatch aimed to destroy her, and Liliana fought her until she was nearly killed, while Emrakul unfolded above Thraben.

"The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: The three titans Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul arrive on Zendikar, and Ugin and Sorin fight their brood as the titans march toward the hedron nexus.
timeline.quote: Ugin breathed his ghostfire, searing the Eldrazi brood with invisible flame.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi stand petrified over Akoum and the chamber is sealed with a lock that requires three Planeswalkers to open.
timeline.quote: Looming above the highlands of Akoum, the three Eldrazi stood petrified, surrounded by a web of floating hedrons.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Jace swears the oath, warning that Emrakul could be drifting through the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Never again. For the sake of the Multiverse, I will keep watch.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains the plan and Ugin reveals that Emrakul is gone from Zendikar and that he knew the titans could be killed.
timeline.quote: Emrakul is gone, and has been for some time.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri calls to the sky for Emrakul to come to Innistrad as the plane trembles.
timeline.quote: Come to me. Come to Innistrad!

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees the temple she constructed for the god no longer empty.
timeline.quote: To the temple she had constructed for the god. It was no longer empty.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: A mad angel announces that Emrakul is rising and dives at Maeli.
timeline.quote: She dove down, her blade slicing through the air ahead of her.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Edith, in a crowd of cultists, begs to be chosen as Emrakul rises.
timeline.quote: Choose me! Me! Me'mrakul.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Emrakul rises from the sea at the Drownyard.
timeline.quote: And then Emrakul rose.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Emrakul looks upon Edith, who feels chosen.
timeline.quote: She looked down at Edith with one enormous, glowing magenta eye.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Bruna and Gisela are gone, becoming one fused angel that proclaims Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Emrakul's angel parted four wings, reached out with two arms, and cried with a single voice that sprang from two mouths

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's angel leads the faithful below in a chorus of We are Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Emrakul's angel led all below in following Her radiant form.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace sees Emrakul for the first time, bigger than the others, with all of Innistrad following her.
timeline.quote: It was the first time he had actually seen Her: the titan, Emrakul.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace asks Emrakul her name and is flooded with words of conquest.
timeline.quote: The beginning—I shall be all.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she brought Emrakul to his doorstep.
timeline.quote: I brought Emrakul to your doorstep, and you still think I'm a child.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri declares she is done being a warden and that Zendikar will never again be a prison, so Emrakul had to go somewhere.
timeline.quote: I'm done being a warden, and Zendikar will never again be a prison.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin, trapped, watches Emrakul drift across Gavony toward Thraben.
timeline.quote: The horizon was Emrakul.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Emrakul unfolds, growing countless tendrils and releasing a wave of power that hits every planeswalker.
timeline.quote: in that shifting Emrakul unfolded

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace finds himself at the top of a spiral staircase in a copy of his Ravnica sanctum while Emrakul tears the tower apart.
timeline.quote: He was at the top of a long, grand spiraling staircase

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Fueled by rage, Liliana draws deeply on the Chain Veil, pushes back against Emrakul and takes back her zombies.
timeline.quote: She felt her zombies return to her.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana blasts Emrakul back with necromantic energy, believing she is winning.
timeline.quote: For the first time since blossoming, Emrakul was shrinking

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana's body begins to fail and Emrakul regrows faster than she can blast it, forcing her onto the defensive.
timeline.quote: now it was all she could do to stand her ground

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana's zombies are destroyed by the hundreds as she fights only to survive another moment.
timeline.quote: Zombies were destroyed by the hundreds under Emrakul's assault

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace returns to find Liliana unconscious and bleeding, and Emrakul fully unfolded above Thraben.
timeline.quote: Liliana was on the ground in front of him, unconscious, bleeding profusely from multiple wounds.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: A silver beam from the moon stretches Emrakul toward it until she snaps, folds and collapses to nothing, bound in the moon.
timeline.quote: Emrakul was gone. They had won.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana, having survived, stares at the moon and curses Emrakul to rot there forever.
timeline.quote: May you rot there forever.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tearfully tells Jace that Emrakul took over her body to read the second scroll.
timeline.quote: It...she...took me over.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo reveals the scroll cast a changed spell that trapped Emrakul herself, leaving them unsure what they did.
timeline.quote: instead it fueled a spell that trapped herself here

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace, alone, recalls the angel's words that it is not her time yet and goes to find a bed.
timeline.quote: It is not my time. Not yet.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: In the trial Nissa suffers a nightmare of an angel who says she can do anything, a voice she realizes was both Emrakul's and her own.
timeline.quote: The monster had taken over her body back on Innistrad.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The woman in violet gives a cold answer, then pours drinks and toasts to new good old days to keep Jace there.
timeline.quote: To new good old days,

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: The Theorist reads Tam's mind, learns she met Emrakul, and says Emrakul will be eliminated by the overwrite; Tam pushes back angrily.
timeline.quote: But he saw enough. "You spoke to Emrakul."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam reaches out with her mind to Emrakul and asks her to feast on the false Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Will you feast at my invitation?

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Emrakul agrees, promising to devour and to heal.
timeline.quote: I will come to devour and to heal.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Emrakul engulfs the sky over Hexhaven.
timeline.quote: Emrakul engulfs the sky.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Emrakul opens her mouth and begins devouring the Echoverse, and doubles of planes fade.
timeline.quote: As the mirrored plane shakes and sputters, it begins to fade.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Liliana senses Emrakul overhead and deduces that Jace's spark went to one specific body.
timeline.quote: Liliana remembers the spark emerging from Jace's chest, flying out the window, seeking a body.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Founder Sphinxes and cadets fight Emrakul as she distinguishes one plane from another and pulls matter into her maw.
timeline.quote: "She is distinguishing one plane from the other!"

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Hexhaven is marked as separate from Strixhaven and begins being drawn into the sky.
timeline.quote: Around her, Hexhaven is marked separate from Strixhaven.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

relations.note: She calls Emrakul to Innistrad and built a temple for her.
relations.quote: Come to me. Come to Innistrad!

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

relations.note: She brought the titan to Innistrad.
relations.quote: I brought Emrakul to your doorstep

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

relations.note: Jace concludes the angel is his mind's personification of Emrakul's emanations.
relations.quote: This was his mind's attempt to make sense of whatever pressures or emanations he was feeling from Emrakul.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.
